name: CarePulse — Hospital Management System
desc: A full-stack hospital management platform connecting patients, doctors, and admins. Features doctor discovery, appointment booking with Stripe payments, role-based dashboards, and platform-wide analytics.
challenges: Managing role-based access control across three user types (patient, doctor, admin) while integrating Stripe payment flow with appointment status lifecycle and doctor onboarding by admin.
plans: Add real-time appointment notifications via WebSocket, introduce prescription management module, and build a telemedicine video consultation feature.

name: CareerPilot — AI-Powered Job & Freelance Marketplace
desc: A full-stack Agentic AI application connecting job seekers with employers through intelligent AI-driven job matching, resume insights, and a smart conversational assistant powered by Groq API (Llama 3.3 70B).
challenges: Integrating context-aware AI chat with conversation history while maintaining role-based authorization across both Next.js frontend and Express backend simultaneously.
plans: Add AI-powered resume builder, expand recommendation engine with more LLM context, and introduce real-time job alert notifications.

name: PromptVerse — AI Prompt Marketplace
desc: A next-generation marketplace for AI engineers and creators to discover, share, evaluate, and manage advanced AI system prompts. Features dynamic filtering by categories and AI tools with a premium dark-themed experience.
challenges: Building a seamless prompt engineering form with ImgBB API synchronization for thumbnail uploads while managing multi-tag parsing and scope metadata allocation.
plans: Integrate live AI testing sandbox so users can run prompts directly in the browser, and add community rating system with analytics dashboard.
